source_quantifiers.statement: For every prime p and every conference matrix W (source def: n x n over {0,+1,-1}, exactly n-1 nonzeros per row and column, W W^T = (n-1) I_n) of order n = p+1, the F_p (= Z_p) row span of W (= reduction of Lambda(W) mod p) is MDS, of dimension (p+1)/2 and minimum Hamming distance (p+3)/2.
